meaning_en: to reduce in kiln / starve kiln atmosphere of oxygen

past.ar: اخْتَزَلَ الصَّانِعُ هَوَاءَ الحَرْقِ عِنْدَ القِمَّةِ
past.de: Der Handwerker drosselte die Luftzufuhr auf dem Brennhöhepunkt
past.en: The artisan reduced the kiln airflow at peak heat

present.ar: يَخْتَزِلُ الأَكَاسِيدَ لِتَتَحَوَّلَ إِلَى صَفِيحَةٍ بَرَّاقَةٍ
present.de: Er reduziert die Oxide zur glänzenden Metallhaut
present.en: He reduces the oxides to form a gleaming metallic film

imperative.de: Reduziere behutsam zum Schutze der Glasur!
imperative.en: Reduce carefully to preserve the glaze integrity!
